project_context: 150 kW rooftop system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario. Budget ceiling $260,000 CAD. Must be complete within 16 weeks of award.

fields.licence: Does the BIDDER ITSELF state that it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence? A licence held by a subcontractor, or one to be obtained later, is NOT the bidder's licence; use value false and status conditional.
fields.wsib_clearance: Does the proposal state that WSIB clearance is held? (true/false)
fields.liability_insurance_amount_cad: Commercial general liability insurance amount stated, as a number in CAD.
fields.qualifying_installs_count: Number of commercial installations of 100 kW or more stated, as a number.
fields.total_price_cad: Total price as a number in CAD.
fields.completion_weeks: Completion time in weeks from award, as a number. If no number of weeks is stated, use not_stated.
fields.panel_warranty_years: Panel warranty length in years, as a number.
fields.workmanship_warranty_years: Workmanship warranty length in years, as a number.
fields.named_project_lead: Is a project lead or manager named or assigned now (not 'to be assigned later')? (true/false)
fields.crew: Is a crew size or crew description stated? (true/false)
fields.safety_plan: Does the proposal include a safety plan? (true/false)
fields.monitoring_plan: Does the proposal include a performance monitoring plan? (true/false)

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by bidder
